**LIVE team-best = cost 60** (Vamshi, manifest 2026-07-02, sha `6b007e6d6665…`), far below this
doc's local 534/862 lineage below. Graph = **one** Einsum `nchx,tc,ndyw,td,ot->nohw`, inits
F[3,10]+C[10,3]=60, **free output**, memory 0. `profile_real_cost` static=profile=60. It is a
rank-3 bilinear cross-draw (row-marker ⊗ col-marker → color), not a perfect-25 identity.

- **Perfect-25 ceiling (cost ≤1) DISPROVEN.** Identity + Transpose(H↔W) both `visible 0/265`.
  Cardinality proof: 2-cell input → any permutation ≤2 non-bg cells, output needs ~30. Dead.
- **Rank-2 Einsum (cost 40) INFEASIBLE.** The 3 diagonal combos (PP→0, E8E8→8, E7E7→7) are
  element-wise squares → first-quadrant points needing 3 distinct origin half-planes; impossible
  in R² (rank ≥3 forced). Numeric: t=2 loss floor 3.99 / 180 restarts vs t=3 2.5e-3.
- **60 is the forced floor**: t=3 forced, input c=10 and output o=10 axes forced → F=30, C=30,
  free output. Any Slice/Scatter alt materializes ≥9000 B memory. **WALL — nothing staged.**
- Full proof + gate lines: `task047/hard_records/perfect25_and_rank2.md`.

## Rule

Single 7-cell and single 8-cell on a 9×9 grid. Output: full row+col cross of 8s through the 8, cross of 7s through the 7; the two crossing cells (r8,c7) and (r7,c8) get color 2; rest bg (derived 2026-06-07).

## Cost analysis

**2026-06-24 — New staged best `row7col6` cost 534.**

Source of truth checked: `K-NeuroGolf-OnnxlyFans/NG_OnnxlyFans_TaskStatus.xlsx` sheet `Tasks` and `Team_Submission/Backend/manifest.csv` both list task047 at **537** (sha b79f9f2dc103...). `row7col6` beats that by 3 bytes.

The 2026-06-12 "1,003 floor proof" was WRONG: it assumed the F32 crops were dissolved (they were in `bitset_and`) but kept the 240B of column Where lanes + 300B colbits. The team caught up: team-best is now **Aditya 862** (manifest 2026-06-19, sha 7a9b76…caf58), which BEAT 1,003 by a cleverer col scheme — a single `col_code_30` [1,1,1,30] (30B) broadcast to 10 channels via ONE `BitwiseAnd(col_code_30, channel_mask[1,10,1,1])`, eliminating bitset_and's 8 column Where lanes (240B). But Aditya re-introduced 312B of F32 Slice crops (ch7 [1,1,7,6]=168B, ch8 [1,1,6,6]=144B) just to ReduceMax the marker row/col.

`einsum_dissolve` = Aditya's bit-packing (channel_mask=[1,0,96,0,0,0,0,6,24,0]; row codes other21/orange38/cyan88; col codes other11/orange70/cyan56) with the 312B crops dissolved per #42 — 4 zero-memory free-input Einsum marginals read r7,c7,r8,c8 as F32 scalars straight off the one-hot input (`bchw,c,h->b` and `bchw,c,w->b`), then Equal-ramp masks rebuild the boundary-correct 9-active code vectors, Pad(const 0) to 30. memory **826 -> 448**, cost **862 -> 537**.

`row7col6` keeps that formulation but source-reads `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_23581191.py`: random `generate()` samples marker rows/cols from `range(1, size - 2)` = 1..6, while `validate()` includes one fixed orange marker at row 7. Shrinking rows to dynamic positions 1..7 and columns to 1..6, then active-padding with the other-code and tail-padding with zero, changes **memory 448 -> 446** and **params 89 -> 88**. Pure 1..6 rows/cols scored 527 but failed visible 2/3 on the official row-7 quirk.

**Current charged tensor breakdown (534):** memory 446 = 300 (`col_bits_30` [1,10,1,30]) + 30 (`row_bits_30`) + 30 (`col_code_30`) + 18 (active-padded row/col code vectors) + 52 (two row masks + two row Where at length 7, two col masks + two col Where at length 6) + 16 (four F32 scalar reads). Params 88 = 20 (`sel7/sel8`) + 30 (`ar30`) + 13 (`posr7/posc6`) + 10 (`channel_mask`) + 6 row/col code scalars + 4 active/tail pad values + 1 pad zero + 2 pad-axis scalars + 2 remaining pad scalars.

**Dissolve #2 (the 300B col_bits_30) priced and REJECTED — it is the genuine #141 floor:**
- The final free `BitwiseAnd(row_bits[1,1,30,1], col_bits[1,10,1,30])` forces ONE operand to carry all 10 channels × full width = 300B. Transposed roles (row carries channels) = same 300B (already in don't-do).
- Free-output **sum-product count-Einsum** route (`Σ_b RB[b,r]·CB[b,c]·CM[b,ch]` -> [1,10,30,30] FREE): a valid 7-bit monochromatic-rectangle scheme making shared-bit-count exactly 0/1 per cell EXISTS and was verified — BUT the runtime bit-plane operands `RB[1,7,30,1]`, `CB[1,7,1,30]` must be F16 (**ORT has NO UINT8 Einsum kernel**, probe-confirmed) = 420B each = **840B > 300B**. No win.
- **OneHot(axis=1)** direct route needs a per-cell color-index plane `[1,30,30]` >= 900B. No win.
- The col_bits 10-channel operand at 300B remains the formulation floor for this BitwiseAnd/free-output rendering of the 4-color cross. No absolute task floor is claimed.

**Why 300 B colbits is the absolute floor for BitwiseAnd free-output:**
The output tensor must be [1,10,30,30] = 9,000 B. For the final BitwiseAnd to be free, it must directly name `output`. BitwiseAnd([1,1,30,1], [1,10,1,30]) → [1,10,30,30] requires one operand to be [1,10,1,30] (or equivalent broadcast). The minimum 10-channel, 30-wide column operand is [1,10,1,30] = 300 B. Any arrangement that makes colbits smaller also makes the OTHER intermediate larger — e.g. transposed encoding ([1,10,30,1] × [1,1,1,30]) keeps total at 300+30=330 B, same. The 9-col approach moves the 300 B charge from colbits to the BitwiseAnd result itself ([1,10,30,9]=2700 B), massively worse.

**Add-broadcast impossibility (mathematical proof):**
The crossing cells need color 2 at exactly (r8,c7) and (r7,c8). For any arithmetic output = f(row_val[r]) + g(col_val[c]), the crossing condition becomes a system a8+b7 = a7+b8 = target with a7+b8 ≠ a8+b8 (rows must differ) AND a8+b7 ≠ a8+b8 (cols must differ). This gives a8>a7 AND a7>a8, a contradiction. No broadcasting Add can express the crossing.

**Verdict (2026-06-24): CANDIDATE staged at 534.** The 300B `col_bits_30` remains the #141 BitwiseAnd-family wall; the 3-byte win comes from source-bounded dynamic masks, not from dissolving that plane.
